cohort: The study included 1090 women with nonmale factor infertility who underwent fresh embryo transfer cycles of IVF or ICSI.
finding: IVF demonstrated significantly higher fertilization, implantation, and chemical pregnancy rates, as well as higher twin birth weights and lower prematurity rates, compared to ICSI for women with advanced maternal age and nonmale factor infertility.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between April 2018 and June 2023.
